Hi Christian,

Understood, and that's fair. You shouldn't have to wrestle with a box you can't even get to while you're away.

On sending a new one out before the damaged unit is back here, that's a call I can't make on my own, so I've put it in front of Georges with everything on it, including the camera video and the carrier going quiet on you. A colleague is picking it up today and will come back to you in this thread with the answer.

Please don't throw the old unit out yet. The prepaid label under reference Shop···· stays valid, so if the answer is that it needs to come back, it can go to UPS whenever you're home again, no rush and no cost to you.

Sorry you're chasing this at all after the wait you've already had.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
